matrix.armor_penetration.description:
Reduces the target's armor and thoughness by 40% for 10 seconds.

Cannot be tracked.
matrix.breaking_bad.description:
Poisons and blinds the target for 10 seconds, dealing continuous damage.

If the target is ignited, it will explode.

Trackable when causing an explosion.
matrix.cripple_movement.description:
Disables the target's teleportation ability and hinders their movement for 10 seconds.

Cannot be tracked.
matrix.decisive_strike.description:
Deals 6 damage to the target, adds extra damage based on the player's base attack damage, and inflicts additional damage equal to 14% of the target's maximum health.

Increases damage by 1% per magics' cost in the channel queue, up to 400%.

Removes the target's invincibility frames upon being hit.

Trackable.
matrix.explosion.description:
Create an explosion at the selected target's location.

Trackable.
matrix.health_steal.description:
Converts 50% of the target's maximum health into additional health for the player.

50% of the converted value is used to restore health, hunger, and saturation.

Cannot be tracked.
matrix.ignite.description:
Ignites the target for 10 seconds, dealing continuous damage.

If the target is poisoned, it will explode.

Trackable when causing an explosion.
matrix.lightning_bolt.description:
Summons lightning at the target's location.

Cannot be tracked.
matrix.mana_overload.description:
Marks a target for 10 seconds. Killing the target during the mark duration restores 20 mana points.

Cannot be tracked.
matrix.memory_erase.description:
Forces the target to forget the currently locked target.

Cannot be tracked.
matrix.redstone_chestplate.description: Consumes power to reduce damage taken: 1 power reduces 4 damage, up to 40% per hit.
matrix.redstone_helmet.power: Electrolytic Breathing: Enables underwater breathing, using §91§r power every §95§r seconds.
matrix.redstone_leggings.description: Chance to damage nearby entities when hit.
matrix.redstone_mining_tool.description: Increases mining speed by 40%. Breaking blocks consumes 1 power.
matrix.redstone_sword.description: Consumes 1 MEU power on attack to deal an additional 2 damage.
matrix.sculk_catalyst.description: After a brief delay, deals massive damage to the target. If the target dies, the magic spreads to the next entity within 20 meters, consuming mana automatically. Each spread reduces the required time, increases the mana cost, and deals more damage. Automatically highlights the spread target.
matrix.sonic_boom.description:
Channel a sonic boom, dealing 10 damage to the target.

The sonic boom ignores armor, any damage-reducing enchantments (e.g., Protection), and shield blocking. It does not trigger the Thorns enchantment, and its damage to witches is reduced by 85%.

Wither Armor can mitigate the damage caused by the sonic boom.

Trackable.
matrix.spread.description:
All magics queued after this one will spread to creatures within 24 meters.

Cannot spread.

Cannot be tracked.
matrix.system_crash.description:
Effective only on players, crashes the target player's system.

Cannot be tracked.
matrix.target_positioning.description:
Highlights the target and all entities within a 24-meter radius for 10 seconds.

Cannot be tracked.
matrix.teleport.description:
Grants invisibility for 10 seconds and teleports to the target's location.

Cannot be tracked.
